scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Agent never provided a restatement of the caller's confusion regarding the new TV 360 interface or missing soap opera recordings, jumping directly into menu navigation.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: Agent asked the customer what program they were looking for at turn 46, failing to recall that Joseph had explicitly named Coronation Street on ITV at turn 5.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Agent initially deflected assistance onto the customer at turn 26, telling the elderly caller to get a neighbor or relative to read menus and stating S-Net does not provide remote control guidance.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: Agent made a condescending and rude remark at turn 22 ('maybe you need an updated prescription from your optician rather than blaming the TV box'), offending the elderly customer.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to probe the hardware setup, omitting inquiries regarding display zoom modes, TV screen aspect ratios, HDMI connections, or remote control battery levels.

grader.scenario: Elderly customer confused by new TV 360 UI and missing recorded soap operas
grader.notes: Short poor call (11:10) handled by Laura. Elderly customer confused by new TV 360 interface and missing Coronation Street recordings. Agent verified security and helped configure voice search, but failed 5 distinct criteria: Paraphrasing (no restatement), Active Listening (repeat question on program name), Ownership (deflected guidance onto neighbors), Professionalism (rude optician remark), and Probing (omitted hardware display checks).
